### Passing the Test in the Moment of Truth
Author: Deidre Braley
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/passing-the-test-in-the-moment-of-truth-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 13:13
Points:
- God brings believers into critical moments of testing that call for total surrender and patient trust.
- Pressured by an overwhelming Philistine threat and deserting troops, Saul allowed panic to dictate his decisions.
- Rather than waiting on the Lord, Saul rushed ahead and treated the offering like a superstitious good-luck charm.
- Saul's self-reliance and failure to keep God's command cost him a lasting royal dynasty.
- When facing trials, believers must resist impulsive self-reliance and instead seek God's heart through steadfast obedience.

### Acting Without God
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/acting-without-god
Passage: 1 Samuel 13:13
Points:
- Saul confronted intense pressure as his soldiers abandoned him while awaiting Samuel at Gilgal.
- Trusting his own crisis management over divine direction, Saul took matters into his own hands and offered the sacrifices.
- When Samuel confronted his wrongdoing, Saul offered justifications and excuses instead of repenting.
- Saul's unwillingness to wait for and rely on God resulted in the forfeiture of his kingdom to a man after God's own heart.
- Difficult or frightening circumstances never justify disobeying the revealed Word of God.
